description: This file defines a widget component for an Android application that displays the 'Word of the Day' from Wiktionary. It includes the main widget provider class and an internal service to perform background updates via API calls, parse the content with regex, and update the widget UI accordingly.

classes.name: WordWidget
classes.description: The main AppWidgetProvider class that manages the widget lifecycle and updates.

classes.name: WordWidget.UpdateService
classes.description: An inner Service class that performs background updates, fetches the word of the day, parses the content, and updates the widget UI.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Triggers a background service to update the widget when an update is needed.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles the start of the update service, builds the widget view, and pushes the update to the home screen.

methods.name: buildUpdate
methods.description: Performs API call to fetch latest page content, parses the relevant data using regex, and constructs the RemoteViews object to reflect the 'Word of the Day'.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used for this service.
